prompts:
FIND: Definition and all call sites of current_session, including its validity checks and returned session data.
SCOPE: src/auth.rs, src/**/*.rs
ATTENTION: Rust authentication flow; report exact file:line references.
EXPECTED: definition, callers, and validation summary

FIND: All comparisons or mutations involving factor_epoch on users and sessions, especially authorization-code redemption.
SCOPE: src/**/*.rs, tests/**/*.rs
ATTENTION: Rust, SQLx, OIDC session invalidation semantics.
EXPECTED: file:line list with comparison behavior

FIND: Existing tests that invalidate or delete sessions after authentication state changes, and tests around authorize/current_session.
SCOPE: src/**/*.rs, tests/**/*.rs
ATTENTION: Reuse the smallest existing Keystone test module and conventions.
EXPECTED: test names plus file:line and fixture pattern
